blogs.title: Goodbye Heavy Compute: How '1.58-Bit' AI Could Run on Your Phone
blogs.description: Explore how the new BitNet b1.58 technology shrinks massive AI models down to tiny fractions of their usual size without losing intelligence. We break down why using just three numbers (-1, 0, 1) instead of complex decimals could revolutionize mobile and edge computing, making powerful language models accessible on everyday devices.

blogs.title: The Green Revolution in AI: Saving Energy Without Sacrificing Smarts
blogs.description: Large Language Models are notorious energy hogs, but a new study suggests we can cut that carbon footprint dramatically. Learn how replacing standard math operations with simple integer additions in the BitNet b1.58 architecture leads to massive energy savings—up to 70x less for calculations—while matching the performance of traditional super-heavy models.

blogs.title: Smaller is Bigger: Why New Scaling Laws Mean Faster, Cheaper AI
blogs.description: The old rule was 'bigger model equals smarter,' but the BitNet b1.58 paper flips the script. Discover the new scaling laws showing that a 70-billion-parameter 1-bit model can outperform a 13-billion full-precision model in speed and efficiency. We analyze what this means for the future cost of running enterprise-grade AI.

blogs.title: Beyond Quantization: Why Training from Scratch Changes Everything
blogs.description: Most current methods try to squeeze existing large models into smaller formats after they are built (post-training quantization), often losing quality along the way. Dive into why BitNet b1.58 takes a different approach by training entirely with ultra-low precision from day one, unlocking unique features like explicit 'feature filtering' that make these lightweight models surprisingly robust.
